title: Functional distillation of pretrained ordinary MLP teacher families into a compact shared Householder-Mirror MLP
hypothesis: Small physical parameter budgets may support multiple reusable teacher MLP functions via task-specific Mirror codes, especially when teachers have a shared function geometry; the effect must be isolated from FiLM and equal-budget independent MLPs.

teacher.type: ordinary learned tanh MLP 4->16->4 (148 physical float parameters per teacher)
teacher.pretraining: AdamW 1100 updates, lr=.012, batch128, 3072 teacher train examples per task, best among 550/825/1100 on independent teacher dev768

teacher_worlds.mirror_related: Train a common ordinary MLP teacher, make 3 ordinary MLPs with first layer H_m W_up, H_m b_up and second layer W_down H_m; random fixed Householder directions. Exact Mirror-oracle expressivity by construction; label this favorable aligned world.
teacher_worlds.film_related: Train same common ordinary MLP teacher, construct 3 ordinary MLPs with task-dependent elementwise hidden activation gains (1+.85*tanh(code)). Exact FiLM-oracle expressivity by construction.
teacher_worlds.independent: Train 3 unrelated ordinary MLP teachers independently on 3 different nonlinear analytic functions. No structure imposed.

teacher.teacher_model: train all 4 pretrained base/independent MLPs per seed and freeze them before student training
teacher.student_cannot_see: the base teacher weights, oracle mirror directions, or task-generating analytic function; student sees only labeled input/function-output pairs with rule ID

student.mirror: Shared W_up, b_up, W_down, b_down; per-task learned H-vector u_m. h_m=H(u_m) tanh(H(u_m) (W_up x+b_up)); output W_down h_m+b_down. Householder applied by fused rank-1 vector expression. No teacher transfer of weights to the trained student.
student.non_mirror_film: Same shared W and exact scalar count; per-task learned H-vector controlling hidden gain 1+.85*tanh(code), with the same tanh nonlinearity.
student.non_mirror_shared: Same hidden width but no per-task code; deliberately smaller shared baseline, not matched-budget.
student.native_control: 3 completely independent ordinary tanh MLPs with per-rule hidden widths 3/7/10 matching mirror width 8/16/24 respectively within 8 percent physical trainable scalar count.
student.initialization: Torch seeded random fresh student initialized separately; same shared-W initial RNG for Mirror/FiLM at matched width

train.student_data: inputs iid Uniform[-1,1]^4 for train/dev/fresh, Uniform[-1.6,1.6]^4 for OOD; disjoint generator seeds per split, world and base seed
train.sampling: fixed per-world+seed stream of 750 batch128 sampled train indices, all 4 arms and 3 widths share stream
train.optimizer: AdamW lr=.012, wd=1e-4, clipping 1.0, CPU FP32, torch threads=1, exactly 750 real student optimizer updates
train.loss: per-example teacher-output MSE divided by squared train-only teacher target mean (floor 1e-5), no CE/softmax
train.checkpoint_selection: DEV NMSE minimum among updates 250,500,750; sealed before fresh; no selection/tuning on fresh or OOD
train.training_cost: measure wall clock seconds separately for each student and teacher training; parameter counts and actual serialized inference bytes; at equal updates FLOPs are not matched
train.oracle_witness: Mirror H16 with pretrained common core + true Householder codes for mirror-related world must reproduce 3 teacher MLPs with max DEV NMSE below 1e-10; neither oracle weights nor codes can initialize the trained student

decisions_frozen.mechanism_exact: Mirror 16 oracle DEV NMSE <1e-10 for all 5 seeds
decisions_frozen.functional_distillation: random-init trained Mirror H16 on mirror-related teacher Fresh NMSE <0.01 for >=4/5 seeds
decisions_frozen.mirror_specific_aligned: mirror-related H16 Mirror has >=10pct lower Fresh NMSE than both same-param FiLM and comparable-param independent student in >=4/5 seeds
decisions_frozen.cross_world_generalizability: H16 Mirror >=10pct lower Fresh NMSE than equal-param FiLM in >=8/15 pairs across all three worlds
decisions_frozen.deployment: Even if quality passes, no deployment advantage without actual output packet bytes, active inference compute, teacher+student training compute and runtime Pareto comparison
decisions_frozen.fail_reporting: Report per-seed paired data, no suppression of unfavorable worlds. Aligned oracle advantage does not establish novelty or generic utility.

prior_art: Model distillation, FiLM, hypernetwork weight generators, meta-learning / parameter tying, Householder parameterization; compare instead of claiming entirely novel framework.
research_integrity: Register on new branch before any training; retain MA-1177 negative conclusions; fresh evaluation only after all student checkpoints hashed. No main merge without user request.
